title: Design, Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of 04 passengers(408Kg) Elevator with SS cabin for Kilakarai Lighthouse station, Tamilnadu.
summary: E-tender (percentage rate, two-cover) for design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of a 4-passenger (408 kg) elevator with stainless steel cabin at Kilakkarai Lighthouse, Ramanathapuram District, Tamil Nadu (Chennai Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Kilakarai Lighthouse, Ramanathapuram District
sites.work: Design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of 04-passenger (408 kg) elevator with SS cabin

scope.item: Design, Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of 04 passengers (408Kg) Elevator with SS cabin

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalised bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai; valid three months from technical bid opening. Tender fee Nil (clause 1.1 still refers to tender fee DD 'as per NIT').

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: (A) Lift manufacturing agency with valid licence/registration from State CEIG or other State/Central licensing authority, with experience in fabrication and erection of steel structural tower for lift and lift installation to minimum 30 m height; OR (B) contractor registered in appropriate category/class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL etc. in joint venture consortium with lift manufacturer (second party to submit CEIG manufacturing licence)

Similar works in last seven years: three each >= 40%, two each >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost; completed works only; value updated at 7% p.a.; certificates below Executive Engineer rank not considered

Similar works: fabrication and erection of steel structural tower for lift and lift installation to minimum 30 m height, and any civil engineering works like RCC towers, steel structures, buildings, bridges, dams, water tanks
Bank solvency certificate for 40% of estimated cost
Average annual turnover on construction works (CA certified) at least 30% of estimated cost in last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2023
P&L statement and audited balance sheet for past five years ending 31 March 2023; ITRs and sales tax clearance for last three years
Litigation/blacklisting information for last 5 years; key personnel details; list of tools & plants and shuttering materials

Tender acceptance letter (Annexure II), unconditional bid undertaking (Annexure III), non-blacklisting affidavit, list of relatives in MoPSW/DGLL, Make in India self-certification (Annexure VII), documents per Section IX evaluation criteria
specs: Passenger elevator, 04 persons / 408 kg capacity, stainless steel cabin

corrigenda.change: Extension of last date: bid document download and online submission extended to 10.09.2025 15:00; bids opened 11.09.2025 15:00 (originally 19.08.2025 / 20.08.2025)

notes: Scanned Section I NIT only; no BOQ or lift specifications. Original download/submission 24.07.2025 14:00 to 19.08.2025 15:00, EMD original by 19.08.2025 15:00, opening 20.08.2025 15:00. Financial criteria reference year ending 31 March 2023, apparently not updated for a 2025 tender. Corrigendum filename says 29.08.2025 but letter dated 28.08.2025. Spelled 'Kilakarai' in NIT and 'Kilakkarai' in corrigendum.
